products.title: Neon Drift 2088
products.subtitle: Own the night. Outrun the city.
products.description: A neon-soaked open-world action RPG set in a vertical megacity where every district runs on stolen memory. Build your crew, tune your ride and decide who gets to remember tomorrow.

products.title: Terrablocks: Build & Survive
products.subtitle: Shape a world. Survive the night.
products.description: Gather, craft and build across a procedurally generated block world. Team up with friends, defend your base and discover what lives beneath the surface.
features: Online co-op for up to 8 players

products.title: Crownfall: Shattered Realm
products.subtitle: A broken crown. A realm to claim.
products.description: A cinematic fantasy RPG about a fallen kingdom, a cursed crown and the unlikely heir who must unite five rival houses before the realm collapses into the void.

products.title: Eclipse Protocol
products.subtitle: When the sun goes dark, the hunt begins.
products.description: A tense sci-fi shooter set aboard a research station during a permanent solar eclipse. Every corridor is a puzzle and every ally has a secret.

products.title: Phantom Blade: Zero Hour
products.subtitle: One blade. No second chances.
products.description: Master precision swordplay in a rain-soaked neo-feudal world. Every duel is decided in seconds and every scar tells a story.

products.title: Farming Frontier 26
products.subtitle: Build a life in the wide open.
products.description: The next generation of the beloved farming sim. Raise animals, restore the old mill and turn a forgotten valley into a thriving community.

products.title: WARDOGS: Black Ops
products.subtitle: No rules. Just the mission.
products.description: A gritty tactical shooter where you lead a deniable squad through collapsing cities and impossible choices. Plans survive only until the first bullet.

products.title: Over the Ridge
products.subtitle: A small story about big horizons.
products.description: Pack a bag and climb a beautiful hand-painted mountain. Meet curious travellers, solve gentle mysteries and decide what to leave behind at the summit.

products.title: Velocity Underground
products.subtitle: The city is your circuit.
products.description: Illegal street racing with a full story mode, deep car tuning and nocturnal city streets that never sleep. Win the scene or lose your ride.

products.title: Aether Legends
products.subtitle: Magic is memory.
products.description: A story-driven RPG where magic is shaped from fragments of forgotten memories. Forge a legacy across floating islands and rival arcane academies.

products.title: Deep Space Salvage
products.subtitle: Everything is worth something. Even you.
products.description: Strip abandoned ships for parts, dodge pirates and keep your crew breathing. A hard-luck space adventure where the quietest wreck hides the biggest secret.

products.title: Shadow Heist
products.subtitle: The perfect crime leaves no trace.
products.description: Plan the impossible and disappear before sunrise. A stealth-action sandbox with persistent cities and a crew that remembers every promise you break.

products.title: Pixel Ranch
products.subtitle: Tiny farm. Big heart.
products.description: A pocket-sized farming and life sim with a pixel-art valley, quirky neighbours and absolutely no deadlines. Plant something. Meet someone. Slow down.

products.title: The Last Signal
products.subtitle: Some frequencies should stay dead.
products.description: You are a night-shift radio operator in a town that disappeared thirty years ago. Answer the signal, chart the darkness and keep the lights on until dawn.

products.title: Nordic Saga: Valhalla
products.subtitle: The final voyage is only the beginning.
products.description: Sail frozen fjords, rally clans and carve your name into a living saga. An open-world Viking epic where legend is the only currency that lasts.

products.title: Crownfall: Veil of Ash
products.subtitle: The crown is not done with you.
products.description: The first major expansion to Crownfall. Journey into the Ashen Reach, master the Emberborn class and uncover what the old queen hid beneath the throne.

products.title: Frostline Expansion Pack
products.subtitle: The north remembers magic.
products.description: Expand Aether Legends with the frozen continent of Norrland. New runes, a tougher endgame and a lost academy waiting beneath the ice.
